p: trespass offering: Which is for the smaller sins, and such as are committed by ignorance.
where they kill the burnt offering: At the court gate.
he shall offer of it all: the high priest.
law for them: The same ceremonies, even though this word trespass signifies less then sin.
therewith shall have it: Meaning, the rest which is left and not burnt.
dry: Because it had no oil or liquor.
thanksgiving: Peace offerings contain a confession and thanksgiving for a benefit received, and also a vow, and free offering to receive a benefit.
vow: If he makes a vow to offer: or else the flesh of the peace offerings must be eaten the same day.
bear his iniquity: The sin for which he offered shall remain.
thing shall not be eaten: After it is sacrificed.
as for the flesh: Of the peace offering that is clean.
hands shall bring the offerings of: And should not send it by another.
anointing of Aaron: that is, his privilege, reward and portion.
consecrations: Which sacrifice was offered when the priests were consecrated, Ex 29:22.
